name: PipeBend
description: A 90-degree pipe bend with a real wall: the swept profile is an annulus, so the bore is open end to end. The BORE leads the parameterisation -- tube_id is frozen as key geometry, the wall is free for the DFM loop, and the outside diameter follows -- because thickening a pipe's wall while keeping what flows through it is exactly the change a moulding loop should be allowed to make. Volume is analytic (Pappus): pi*(od^2-id^2)/4 * (pi*bend_r/2).

parameters.name: tube_id
parameters.comment: the bore: what flows through is the function, so it is frozen

parameters.name: wall
parameters.comment: pipe wall -- free for the DFM loop to move

parameters.name: tube_od
parameters.comment: follows the wall, keeping the bore
